regime_read: Convergence favors AI compute, memory, software, and federal-technology spending, but several signals are sentiment-heavy or politically conflicted. The track record is directionally encouraging but only two calls have been scored, so confidence remains provisional.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号汇聚偏向AI算力、存储、软件及联邦科技支出，但部分信号较依赖市场情绪，或存在政治交易方向冲突。历史记录方向上积极，但仅有两条已评分判断，因此置信度仍属暂定。

theses.thesis: IBM has the cleanest operating convergence: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity aligns with insider buying pressure, a large patent cluster, and open-source momentum [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. Its modest relative strength leaves the signal unextended, although earnings in 12 days introduce near-term event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM的经营型信号汇聚最为清晰：联邦合同活动显著加速，同时出现内部人买入压力、大规模专利集群及开源生态动能 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。其相对强度仍温和，尚未过度延伸，但12个交易日后的财报带来近期事件风险。
second_order: Federal IT modernization — IBM's contract acceleration implies broader demand for government cloud, integration, and cybersecurity suppliers
MSFT — established enterprise-cloud exposure could benefit if federal technology procurement is broad rather than vendor-specific
theses.dissent: The contract acceleration may reflect lumpy awards rather than durable revenue growth, while the imminent earnings event can overwhelm the alternative-data signal.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract activity normalizes without corresponding commercial momentum, or management indicates that recent awards will not materially support growth.

theses.thesis: NVDA shows broad demand and influence alignment across analyst upgrades, developer activity, model downloads, patents, disclosed political holdings, and a Trump-linked buy signal [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul] [trump]. Positive dark-pool intensity adds a market-structure confirmation, while relative performance is not extended [dark_pool_accumulation].
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA在需求与影响力层面呈现广泛汇聚，包括分析师集中上调、开发者活动、模型下载、专利、已披露的政界持仓以及特朗普关联买入信号 [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul] [trump]。偏强的暗池强度进一步提供市场结构确认，且相对表现尚未过度延伸 [dark_pool_accumulation]。
second_order: MU — expanding AI accelerator deployment raises demand for high-bandwidth and data-center memory
AMAT — sustained semiconductor capacity investment benefits wafer-fabrication equipment suppliers
Data-center power and cooling — greater accelerator density increases supporting infrastructure requirements
theses.dissent: Several channels reflect expectations and attention rather than incremental end demand, leaving the read vulnerable if AI infrastructure spending slows.

falsifier.text: Developer and model-use momentum weakens while major customers reduce or defer AI infrastructure spending.

theses.thesis: MU combines accelerating government grants, insider buying pressure, a substantial patent cluster, and strongly bullish retail positioning [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. This also fits the second-order memory demand implied by NVDA's developer and model momentum, but the Trump-linked sell signal is an explicit conflict [trump].
theses.thesis_zh: MU同时出现政府补助加速、内部人买入压力、较大的专利集群及强烈看多的散户情绪 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。该信号也符合NVDA开发者及模型动能所隐含的二阶存储需求，但特朗普关联卖出信号构成明确冲突 [trump]。
second_order: AMAT — stronger memory investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand
AI-server memory — greater accelerator deployment increases high-bandwidth-memory requirements
Advanced packaging — tighter integration of compute and memory raises packaging complexity
theses.dissent: Bullish retail positioning may be crowded, and the political sell signal conflicts with the otherwise positive operating evidence.

falsifier.text: Memory demand or pricing weakens while grant acceleration fails to translate into additional domestic capacity economics.

theses.thesis: MSFT's consumer demand, model-ecosystem momentum, patent activity, Trump-linked buying, and partnership with Sam Altman point in the same direction [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]. However, relative strength is already close to the desk's extension threshold, making entry discipline more important than the positive convergence.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的消费者需求、模型生态动能、专利活动、特朗普关联买入以及与Sam Altman的合作关系方向一致 [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster] [trump] [actor:Sam Altman]。不过，其相对强度已经接近本桌的过度延伸阈值，因此当前更应强调入场纪律，而非追逐正面汇聚。
second_order: NVDA — continued cloud AI demand supports accelerator consumption
Data-center power and cooling — cloud expansion requires additional electrical and thermal infrastructure
Enterprise AI software — strong model usage can broaden adoption across workflow and security applications
theses.dissent: The signal may already be substantially reflected in relative performance, while model downloads and app ratings do not ensure incremental monetization.

falsifier.text: Model usage and app demand stop growing without a corresponding increase in enterprise AI revenue.

theses.thesis: Government-contract acceleration aligns with developer momentum, bullish retail sentiment, and disclosed political and fund affiliations [gov_contract_accel] [github_momentum] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. The operating signal is constructive, but the stock is explicitly extended after materially outperforming SPY, so the evidence supports monitoring rather than chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: 政府合同加速与开发者动能、看多散户情绪，以及已披露的政界和基金关联相互呼应 [gov_contract_accel] [github_momentum] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。经营信号偏积极，但该股相对SPY已大幅跑赢并被明确标记为过度延伸，因此这些证据只支持观察，不支持追高。
second_order: IBM — broader federal technology modernization could benefit another established government IT supplier
Federal data integration — PLTR's contract momentum implies demand for analytics, cloud, and cybersecurity implementation
MSFT — government analytics workloads can pull through cloud-compute consumption
theses.dissent: The combination of extreme relative strength and uniformly bullish retail sentiment raises crowding and reversal risk.

falsifier.text: Government-contract momentum decelerates while developer activity weakens and the stock remains priced for rapid growth.

track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
